subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can remember the Unit 1 routines and times of the day.
I can use I / We, don't and When do you ...?

tf.s: Two children are eating breakfast. We say We have breakfast.
We use I when we talk about two children.
tf.why: For two children we use We.

tf.s: We go to bed at night.
tf.why: Yes! At night we go to bed.

tf.s: I don't have art lessons means no art lessons for me.
We have dinner in the morning.
tf.why: We have dinner in the evening.

tf.s: For one-word answers in the exam, we write only one word.
A picture with the moon shows the morning.
Basim has breakfast in the morning.
tf.why: The text says I have breakfast in the morning.

boxes.q: When do you go to bed?
boxes.why: We go to bed at night.

boxes.q: Two children eat breakfast. I or We?
When do you have dinner? In the ___.
A girl paints with a red cross. Which sentence?
When do you go to school? In the ___.
boxes.why: We go to school in the morning.

boxes.q: Which clue shows night in a picture?
boxes.why: The moon is in the sky at night.

boxes.q: Complete: My name is Basim. I have ___ in the morning.
boxes.why: Basim has breakfast in the morning.

boxes.q: How many words do you write in a one-word answer?

hunt.q: We go to school in the ___

mcq.q: Which routine is in the evening?
mcq.why: We have dinner in the evening.

mcq.q: Which word means a time of the day?
mcq.why: Afternoon is a time of the day.

mcq.q: Which question asks about the time of a routine?
o: When do you have art lessons?
How many desks can you see?

mcq.q: Which word do we spell b-e-d?
Write: When do you go to school?
o: We go to school in the morning.
We go to school at night.
We go to school in night.

mcq.q: Picture: two children and tennis with a red cross. Which sentence?
mcq.why: Two children and a cross: We don't play tennis.

mcq.q: When do you have dinner? Write one word: In the ___.

o: We go to bed in night.
We get up in the morning.
We have lunch in the afternoon.
We have dinner in the evening.

mcq.q: The sun is high in the sky and children eat lunch. Which time is it?
Which list is in the right order for a day?
o: get up, go to school, do homework, go to bed
go to bed, get up, do homework, go to school
do homework, get up, go to bed, go to school
go to school, go to bed, get up, do homework
mcq.why: We start with get up and finish with go to bed.
